name: device-code-prompt
title: Device Code Prompt
description: DeviceCodePrompt: the "go to this address and enter this code" step of a sign-in by device code (OAuth device authorization, RFC 8628) at a third-party provider. The code through PairingCode (grouped, monospaced, spelled out for screen readers, with copy), the verification page as an external link that opens in a new tab, an Open button that prefers the address with the code filled in, an optional copy of the link, and a countdown that announces itself sparingly and switches to expired. Agents never read the code or the link by default.
docs:
`<DeviceCodePrompt code="WDJB-MJHT" verificationUri="https://provider.example/device" verificationUriComplete="https://provider.example/device?user_code=WDJB-MJHT" expiresAt={flow.expiresAt} onExpire={restart} copyLink text={{ instructions: (link) => <>Go to {link} and enter this code.</>, open: "Open sign-in page", expiresIn: (_ms, time) => `Code expires in ${time}`, expired: "This code has expired." }} />`.

**Code.** It renders PairingCode: `code` with or without separators, `groupSize` (4) and `separator` ("-") shape it and what its copy button writes, `size="lg"` makes it bigger, and a screen reader spells it out. `labels.code` names it ("Code"), `labels.pairingCode` passes PairingCode's own labels, and `onCopy(code)` runs after a copy.

**Link.** `text.instructions(link)` is the sentence around the verification page: a Link with `external`, `newTab` (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, `labels.newTab` read after it) and `fast={false}`, shown without its scheme. Open opens `verificationUriComplete` when given, since it fills the code in, and `verificationUri` otherwise, in a new tab without an opener, then calls `onOpen(uri)`. `copyLink` adds an icon button that copies `verificationUri` and announces `labels.linkCopiedAnnouncement`. `actions` adds controls after Open, like a Cancel.

**Expiry.** `expiresAt` (a Date or epoch ms) shows `text.expiresIn(remainingMs, "m:ss")` each second in a `role="timer"`, announced politely once a minute and at 30, 20 and 10 seconds. When it passes, the code, the link and Open go away (`actions` stay), `text.expired` shows and is announced, and `onExpire` runs once; an agent's `open` then fails with "the code has expired".

**Agents.** The prompt is a `device-code-prompt` group (named by `labels.prompt`, "Sign-in code", or `aria-label`) with `expired` in its state and `open()` and `copyLink()` actions. `agentHidden` is on by default, because the code signs an account in at the provider: the code, the link, Open and both copy buttons sit under `data-agent-hidden`, `verificationUri` stays out of the state, and `open`, `copyLink` and the code's `copy` fail the step with why, while a person still uses them all. `agentHidden={false}` puts `verificationUri` in the state and lets agents open and copy. Every visible word comes from `text`; `labels` holds the accessible names and announcements, in English by default.
